description: I am building Mexico Fire Record for the challenge Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. It is a bilingual website that puts NASA satellite heat detections over Mexico from 2000 to 2026 on one scale and shows how much to trust each number. My interests are open data, data visualization and tools that help people act on what satellites see. The project is already built and I am submitting it on my own, so I am not looking for new members.
